description: This file is a C++ source file containing unit tests for the MaintenanceManager component, utilizing the Google Test framework. It includes test classes, mock setup, and multiple test cases for methods such as setMaintenanceMode, getMaintenanceActivityStatus, getMaintenanceStartTime, as well as event handling scenarios related to maintenance events.
